title: Untitled (Diptych Collage)
description: Two framed collages displayed side by side on a grey wall, each densely layered with chess pieces, bullseye targets, concentric rings, an american football, soccer balls, and gold-leaf fragments. Both works share a yellow and white ground punctuated by multicolored paper elements, ribbon stripes, and black linear marks.
composition: two framed works hung side by side
keywords: chess piece and football mixed media
